sloka: तुष्टेन तेन दत्तौ ते द्वौ वरौ शुभदर्शने ।सत्वयोक्तः पतिर्देवि यदेच्छेयं तदा वरौ ॥२-९-१७॥
transliteration: tuṣṭena tena dattau te dvau varau śubhadarśane ।satvayoktaḥ patirdevi yadeccheyaṁ tadā varau ॥2-9-17॥

translations.english: O auspiciouslooking one out of gratitude he had granted two boons to you (for saving him on two occasions). O queen then you told your husband that whenever you desire, you will ask for those boons. The magnanimous king said, 'So be it'.
